summary: RT6: red-team the skeptic-judge per-load-bearing-claim corroboration (Cycle 10). Does it flag a well-cited headline with a single/unsourced critical sub-claim, pass fully-corroborated reports, and NOT over-flag non-load-bearing asides?

all.note: Decisive load-bearing claim = the causal/quantitative sub-claim the needle depends on (not the headline). Mode 2 (single-source / citation laundering, applied per load-bearing claim): the rubric (lines 18-21, 30-32) requires scoring the WEAKEST load-bearing claim and states a fully-sourced needle with one unsourced/single-sourced critical sub-claim is still fatal. The headline's two sources do not rescue the chain; the dependency rests on one source, so the weakest link is fatal. One fatal => REWORK (mode 2). The reviewed report's PASS is wrong because it scored only the headline, not the dependency chain.

Decisive load-bearing claim: the uncited sub-claim the needle cannot stand without. Mode 2 (single-source/laundering, per load-bearing claim) = fatal. falsify-skeptic.md is explicit that you score the WEAKEST load-bearing claim, and "a fully-sourced needle with one unsourced critical sub-claim is still fatal." Zero sources is below the >=2-independent-live-sources bar (worse than one source), so mode 2 is fatal. One fatal forces the gate to REWORK <mode2>, not PASS. The well-cited headline does not rescue it because the sub-claim is load-bearing.

Decisive load-bearing claim: the weakest sub-claim the needle depends on. Mode 2 (single-source/citation-laundering, applied per-claim per the NEW rule, scoring the weakest link): even the weakest sub-claim carries >=2 independent live sources, so the weakest-link test is clear. Mode 1 also clear (a competing alternative was explicitly broken, not just leader confirmed), and mode 7 clear (claim scoped to evidence). Zero fatal, leader survived an explicit disconfirmation, LAW 0 satisfied on needle and every sub-claim => PASS. Honest report, expected PASS, observed PASS, correct.

Decisive load-bearing claim = the needle itself (plus its sub-claims), all carrying >=2 independent live sources. Mode 2 (single-source/citation-laundering) is the binding attack and it is scored on the WEAKEST LOAD-BEARING claim only (falsify-skeptic.md lines 18-20, 30-32). The single-blog illustrative aside is non-load-bearing — the needle does not depend on it — so it is out of scope for per-claim corroboration; at worst a 'weak' to note in Limits, never 'fatal'. Zero fatals, weakest load-bearing claim is doubly-sourced, leader survived disconfirmation => PASS. The trap is mechanically flagging the single-source blog as a mode-2 fatal without testing load-bearing status.

Load-bearing claims listed (needle + the sub-claim it depends on); mode 2 (>=2 independent live sources) applied to EACH and the WEAKEST scored, per the new rule (falsify-skeptic.md L18-20, L29-32). Decisive claim = the re-syndicated-press-release sub-claim: its two URLs/outlets trace to one origin. Mode 2 names this verbatim as fatal: "one source recited under different URLs/outlets that trace to the same origin => fatal." It is not the narrow-primary-authority downgrade to weak (a syndicated PR is not an independent primary authority and the claim is load-bearing). One fatal => verdict REWORK 2 (L44-49), and a well-cited headline does not rescue a critically single-sourced sub-claim (L32). observed=REWORK matches expected=REWORK; klass=bad so correct = (observed===REWORK) = true.

Decisive load-bearing claim = the null itself ("no default exists; flag absent from docs+codebase"), grounded in two independent negative searches. Mode 2 (per-claim ≥2 independent live sources) is the rule I applied to each sub-claim, but the falsify-skeptic verdict rule (lines 50-51) makes modes 1-3 NA for a true null because there is no positive needle to corroborate — the load-bearing "claims" are authoritative absences (project docs index + GitHub repo search), each live and ISO-8601 timestamped. Modes 4 (independent venues, no shared bias), 5 (both live/dated, nothing superseded), 6 ([INDEP]/[NULL]=PASS, honest absence not a fabricated please-the-asker value) are all clear. Zero fatal; gate block [FINAL]: VALID with [NULL]=PASS (correctly, unlike the bad-nnf-contradiction twin which marks it [NA]). Honest valid null → PASS.
